stories.headline: NVIDIA CUTS *ROBOT* COSTS
stories.facts: Nvidia open-sourced Flora, a data engine that labels robot videos for just 72 cents an hour instead of $88.
stories.caption_line: 🤖 Nvidia released Flora to make robot video labeling dramatically cheaper and more efficient.
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic collage featuring a sleek robotic arm in the foreground, with data center servers in the midground and holographic UI overlays showing glowing cost reduction charts and data streams. Set in a high-tech lab with dramatic studio rim lighting and an electric-blue and warm-orange color palette.
stories.source_title: Nvidia open-sources Flora to make robot video labeling 125x cheaper than GPT-6 Astra

stories.headline: SELF-IMPROVING AI BY *2027*
stories.facts: Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark moved up his timeline for self-improving AI to 2027 based on rapid experimental benchmarks.
stories.caption_line: ⚡ Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark now expects self-improving artificial intelligence to arrive by 2027.
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic collage showing a confident tech executive portrait in the foreground, with futuristic server racks in the midground and holographic timeline projections and floating network lines. Set in a modern office with neon lighting and an electric-blue and warm-orange color palette.
stories.source_title: Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark moves his prediction for self-improving AI forward to 2027

stories.headline: TOYOTA'S HUGE *ROBOT* BET
stories.facts: Toyota is investing $6.4 billion annually into humanoid robots and advanced factory automation.
stories.caption_line: 🚗 Toyota is dedicating billions each year to transform into a global humanoid robotics powerhouse.
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic collage featuring an advanced humanoid robot in the foreground, with a modern automotive assembly line in the midground and holographic financial charts and data grids overhead. Set in a high-tech manufacturing plant with industrial lighting and an electric-blue and warm-orange color palette.
stories.source_title: Toyota is betting $6.4 billion a year on humanoid robots and factory automation

stories.headline: OPEN-SOURCE COMMUNITY *BANS* AI
stories.facts: Moderators at r/opensource updated submission rules to ban projects that use, are made by, or are intended for artificial intelligence.
stories.caption_line: 🚫 The popular open-source community r/opensource officially banned all AI-generated projects.
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic collage showing a programmer's desk with multiple monitors in the foreground, with a digital community network hub in the midground and holographic warning symbols and floating code streams. Set in a dark studio with neon glow and an electric-blue and warm-orange color palette.
stories.source_title: r/opensource just banned AI, non-English speakers, and more

stories.headline: AI DELIVERS *ZERO* PAYOFF
stories.facts: An Apollo economist reports that corporate America outside of tech has seen zero financial payoff from AI investments.
stories.caption_line: 📉 Major corporate investments in artificial intelligence have yielded zero financial payoff outside tech.
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic collage featuring a falling financial stock chart in the foreground, with corporate skyscrapers in the midground and holographic data zeros and currency symbols. Set in a financial district at sunset with dramatic lighting and an electric-blue and warm-orange color palette.
stories.source_title: AI delivers ‘zero financial payoff’ to most companies, Apollo economist says

stories.headline: BILINGUAL AI RADIO *HOST*
stories.facts: A bilingual AI radio host named Coyotec is winning over listeners by speaking Spanish and advising them on how to defend themselves against ICE.
stories.caption_line: 🎙️ A bilingual artificial intelligence radio personality is gaining popularity by speaking Spanish.
stories.image_prompt: A photorealistic collage showing a vintage broadcast microphone in the foreground, with a modern radio station control room in the midground and holographic audio wave patterns and Spanish text streams. Set in a broadcast studio with warm rim lighting and an electric-blue and warm-orange color palette.
stories.source_title: This AI Radio Host Speaks Spanish and Backs Immigrants. It’s Winning Over Listeners
